from itertools import product

def pack_opts(k,W=17):
 shapes=[np.rot90(x,-k) for x in [A,G,B]]
 base=np.zeros((7,W),int);base[:,W-5:]=R
 pls=[]
 for si,sh in enumerate(shapes):
  cur=[]
  for r in range(8-sh.shape[0]):
   for c in range(W-sh.shape[1]+1):
    mask=np.zeros_like(base);mask[r:r+sh.shape[0],c:c+sh.shape[1]]=sh
    if not np.any(mask*base):cur.append((r,c,mask))
  pls.append(cur)
 best=[]
 for pa in pls[0]:
  for pg in pls[1]:
   if np.any(pa[2]*pg[2]):continue
   for pb in pls[2]:
    if np.any((pa[2]+pg[2])*pb[2]):continue
    canv=base+pa[2]+pg[2]+pb[2]
    # every nonanchor object has at least one edge contact with some other shape
    masks=[pa[2],pg[2],pb[2],base]
    contact_each=[]
    for i,m in enumerate(masks[:3]):
     others=sum(masks[j] for j in range(4) if j!=i)
     dil=np.zeros_like(m)
     dil[1:]+=m[:-1];dil[:-1]+=m[1:];dil[:,1:]+=m[:,:-1];dil[:,:-1]+=m[:,1:]
     contact_each.append(np.any((dil>0)&(others>0)))
    if not all(contact_each):continue
    left=np.where(canv)[1].min();width=W-left
    contacts=sum(np.sum((canv[:,c-1]>0)&(canv[:,c]>0)) for c in range(1,W))
    from scipy.ndimage import label
    comps=label(canv)[1]
    best.append((width,contacts,-comps,(pa[:2],pg[:2],pb[:2]),canv))
 return sorted(best,key=lambda x:(x[0],-x[1],x[2]))
